observations: WorldCity.allZones resolves every TimeZone.knownTimeZoneIdentifiers entry; derived zones carry no coordinates and report daylight == nil with DaylightWindow.unavailable.
DaylightWindow.compute samples the city's local day in 600 s steps and bisects each horizon crossing 24 times against -0.833 degrees.
Sydney detail sheet shows an orange day segment between sunrise 07:06 and sunset 18:52 for the reference instant; Shanghai shows the neutral unknown bar with explicit explanatory text.
Both sheets were inspected as exported PNG attachments from the passing runs.
limitations: Sonnenstand bleibt eine Offline-Naeherung niedriger Ordnung (NOAA), keine Ephemeride, keine Refraktion, keine Hoehenlage.
Zonen ohne kuratierte Koordinaten zeigen bewusst keinen Tagesverlauf.
Keine Originalabnahme der Detailansicht; F068 bleibt parity_accepted false und #53 offen.
